Wrote the full verified solution to **`~/solution-go-e2e-burn-poll-window.md`**.

## Summary

**Diagnosis.** The harness injects `test-fake-key-not-a-real-secret` when `LLM_API_KEY` is unset. Two defects compound:
1. No skip guard → real-LLM E2E tests make a doomed request and poll until the full timeout (measured a naive 3.003s burn against an always-401 provider).
2. No deterministic test of the fail-fast path → auth-retry regressions go unnoticed.

**Fix (implemented and verified as a self-contained module at `/tmp/llmfix`):**
- `internal/harness/e2e_skip_test.go` → `skipWithoutRealLLMKey(t)` calls `t.Skipf` with a named reason when the key is unset, equals the fake placeholder, or looks like a placeholder. Each real-LLM test calls it first.
- `internal/llm/fastfail_test.go` → `TestLLMClient_FastFailOnInvalidKey` uses an `httptest` server returning 401 and asserts typed `*APIError`, status 401, an actionable `LLM_API_KEY` hint, and <1s (observed **~0.6ms**).
- Keeps live tests runnable when a real key is set.

**Verification results:**
| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| Fast-fail test | PASS, 626µs |
| Key unset | `SKIP` in ~0ms, named reason |
| Fake placeholder key | `SKIP` in ~0ms, named reason |
| Real key | PASS (live body runs) |
| `gofmt` / `go vet` / `go test ./...` | clean in all key states |

The document contains the exact code, copy-paste commands, an `rg` sweep to catch unguarded tests, an acceptance checklist, and repo-application steps. Note: this environment had no checkout of the consensus repo, so the pattern was reproduced and validated in an isolated Go module; adapt package/type names (`llm.FakeAPIKey`, `APIError`) when dropping it into the real tree.
